newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's CFG index modifies its listed stocks.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's CFG index modifies its listed stocks.

text.p: Casablanca Finance Group (CFG), one of the Moroccan stock market's three indices, on Friday modified the list of companies it monitors closely on the bourse, a spokesman said.
The Casablanca-based CFG 25 tracks the 25 most liquid stocks on a daily basis.
"The composition of CFG index was modified by introduction of the recently privatised steel giant Sonasid to replace Cadem cement firm," said Ismail Douiri, analyst at Casablanca.
The change was based on three criteria - market capitalisation, liquidity and sector representation, he said.
CFG 25 index represents 85.6 percent of the global market capitalisation, Douiri added.

Among the stocks CFG index monitors are the country's private holdings of ONA Group, and Societe Nationale d'InvestissemenT, five banks, four credit firms, four agro-industry companies, Samir oil refinery, five cement firms and other industrial and transportation units.
CFG company was established in 1992 and launched its index in 1993. The index reached 6870.22 points on Thursday from 5195.82 a year ago, stockbrokers said.
The other indices are Upline Securities (USI), which tracks the 10 most liquid stocks and the bourse all-share index.
Established in 1929, the Casablanca stock market has 46 listed companies.
